tei:div.tei:p: (703)bka' srung ma mgon lcam dral lasaḥ ma mo mkha' 'gro'i 'khrugs skong bzhugasaḥ (704)

srid pa ma mo dal la 'dudaḥ dus na snyigs ma shar ba'i tsheḥ bsam ngan dar bas las ngan 'tshubasaḥ nad mtshon mu ge'i bskal ba daraḥ de tshe ma mo mkha' 'gro 'khrugasaḥ 'khrugs skong 'di la 'bad pa gcesaḥ chos 'byung bsnol ma'i steng nyid duḥ mkha' 'gro'i gtor ma sad 'dab canaḥ sha khrag snying sna modas kyis brgyanaḥ srog chags mdangs sam de'i gzugs brnyanaḥ nad mchod bhandha mda' dar tshogasaḥ phye mar dkar mo lag g.yas bshamasaḥ yi dam lha yi ting 'jin dang ཿ ldan pas (705) sngags drug phyag rgyas brlabaḥ bhyoḥ snang srid kun gyi phywa chen moḥ nam mkha' dbyings phyug dpal mo btsanaḥ sra ba'i dbyings dang gnyen pa'i dbyingasaḥ dro dang bskyod pa'i dbyings chen moḥ rgyal ba kun gyi yum chen teḥ ma mo mkha' 'gro'i bdag nyid yinaḥ rang bzhin ngang las ma g.yos phyiraḥ (706)gshes byon bzhags par yi dmigs kyang ཿ gdul bya'i don du sna tshogs skuraḥ ston la phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bulaḥ dam tshig nyams chags mthol lo bshagasaḥ 'byung lnga'i bsdus pa'i snod bcud laḥ rang rgyud bltas shing brnyas pa shoraḥ srid gsum ye nas sangs rgyas suḥ gnas pa la rtogs mthol lo bshagasaḥ bhyoḥ rdo rje phag mo dbyings kyi yumaḥ khros ma nag mo seng ge'i zhalaḥ nyid zhi bde (707)mchog mu kha leḥ ku ru kulle 'od zer canaḥ sna tshogs yum dang yum chen moḥ khrag 'thung gnas bcu dur khrod brgyadaḥ nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas yul bdagaḥ gsang sngags rigs sngags can rnams laḥ phyag 'tshal phyi nang mchod pa 'bulaḥ bstan pa rgya mtsho'i 'dul ba dang ཿ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dang ཿ sngags kyi 'da' dka' dam tshig gnyeraḥ spyi dang khyad par lhag (708)pa yiḥ rnam par phye zhing bsdus po cogaḥ nyon mongs dug lnga'i dbang gyur teḥ bag med 'gal 'khrul thal ba dang ཿ klong du ma gyur nongs pa kunaḥ mthol lo bshags so dag par stsolaḥ bhyoḥ 'jig rten 'das kyang 'khor ba'i tshulaḥ zhi la gnas kyang thugs rje'i gzugasaḥ

e ka tsa ṭi spun drug dang ཿ bran mo bcu bzhi yang g.yog 'bumaḥ 'dod khams bdag mo re ma tiḥ ming brgya ma la mtshan stong (709)maḥ sna tshogs gzugs dang rdzu 'phrul canaḥ stong khams khyab par sprul nas kyang ཿ 'byung ba g.yo dang 'khrug byed cing ཿ dus bzhi'i drod 'jin bcud kyang 'phrogaḥ nad dang rims kyi bdag mo mjadaḥ dben gnas nyul zhing tshogs khang 'grimaḥ rnal 'byor can la dngos grub steraḥ dam tshig nyams la chad pa gcodaḥ legs nyes stangs 'jin 'jig rten skyong ཿ kun la phyag (710)'tshal mchod pa 'bulaḥ tshogs kyi 'khor los nyams chags bshagasaḥ mdos dang mdangs kyis thugs dam bskang ཿ mi nad phyugs nad gcad du gsolaḥ zhing la sad ser btsa' than dang ཿ mu ge 'khrug rtsod med par mjodaḥ bhyoḥ ma mo 'khrug pa'i rgyu bstan paḥ dam pa'i rdo rje slob dpon laḥ ma dad log par rtogs pa bshagasaḥ dbang bskur zab mo thob byas nasaḥ bsnyen sgrub phyag rgya g.yel ba bshagasaḥ (711)dam tshig gcig pa'i spun grogs laḥ gshe skur khros dang mkhon pa bshagasaḥ sems can pha ma'i rang bzhin laḥ ngan sems gnod pa byas pa bshagasaḥ sngags kyi lta spyod gsang sgrogs dang ཿ dam rdzas spang len bgyis pa bshagasaḥ bud med shes rab rang bzhin laḥ brnyas dang log lta bgyis pa bshagasaḥ snang srid lha dang lha mo laḥ dgra gnyen phyogs ris phye ba bshagasaḥ lta ba sgom gyi (712)la ma bzlosaḥ tha mal 'og 'gyur song ba bshagasaḥ spyod pa kun tu bzang po laḥ kha na ma tho 'phog pa bshagasaḥ bhyoḥ khyad par ma mo 'khrugs pa lasaḥ 'jig rten mi bde 'byung ba'i rgyuḥ dge 'dun sde 'khrug hor las byedaḥ khyim pa sun 'byin bshas ra 'grimaḥ sngags pa dam med mthu gtad byedaḥ bskyed rdzogs gdeng bral zog chos 'tshong ཿ skye bo mna' za dug sbyor gsholaḥ dge 'dun khrims nyams pha ma bsluḥ (713)rkun jag rngon pa'i las kyis 'tshoḥ phan tshun 'thab cing ma rabs spyodaḥ ming sring mnol zhing nal bu gsodaḥ

de 'dra'i las ngan shar tsa naḥ mkha' 'gro g.yel zhing ma mo 'khrugasaḥ ma g.yel ma g.yel thugs rjes dgongasaḥ tshogs gtor mdangs kyis thugs dam bskang ཿ sems can nyon mongs rang bzhin laḥ dgongs te tshongs pa'i dngos grub stsolaḥ mi phyugs nad rims god kha sogasaḥ zhi (714)nas 'jig rten bde legs mjodaḥ bhyoḥ yang cig ma mo 'khrugs pa'i rkyenaḥ byi nam lha mo'i sras mchog laḥ khros dang brngan sbyin ma byas bshagasaḥ bong drel lha mo'i bzhon pa laḥ sgrog dang brdeg btsog byas pa bshagasaḥ sha rkyang lha mo'i mthun rdzas laḥ rngon byas ku cos dkrogs pa bshagasaḥ bya nag lha mo'i nor yin kyang ཿ bskrad dang mngon spyod byas pa bshagasaḥ phag rdzi lha mo'i mja' gcugs laḥ ngan (715)smras gnod pa byas pa bshagasaḥ rma bya lha mo'i brgyan yin kyang ཿ spyugs dang khyo shug dpral ba bshagasaḥ mgar yugs lha mo'i grib yin kyangaḥ nye par bkol zhing brten pa bshagasaḥ thab gzhom lha mo'i dug yin kyang ཿ dbang med ma tshor shor ba bshagasaḥ mdor na dbyings kyi rje mo yiḥ thugs la khro ba mi mnga' yang ཿ 'khor gyi ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogasaḥ skyon mthong tsam nas chad pa gcodaḥ (716)de phyir 'gal 'khrul nongs pa kunaḥ sbed par mi bgyid 'chab ma lagasaḥ brngan gyi mchog tu tshogs gtor dang ཿ ja gad phud kyis thugs dam bskang ཿ mdangs kyi mchog tu mchog phran gyiḥ sha khrag drod dbugs skye mched 'bulaḥ lha 'dre yid kyi gzugs can laḥ zho shas brten pa'i sha khrag drodaḥ rang rgyud can du ma mchis pasaḥ sha med sha yis thugs dam bskang ཿ khrag med khrag gis thugs dam bskang ཿ (717)drod med drod kyis thugs dam bskang ཿ srog gi rang bzhin rlung yin teḥ dbugs med dbugs dang srog med srogaḥ de las bskyed pa'i bkrag mdangs kyisaḥ ma mo mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang ཿ thugs dam gnyen po bskangs gyur nasaḥ nyams chags 'khon 'jin dag pa dang ཿ ma mo mkha' 'gro 'khrugs pa yiḥ

rgyu rkyen 'bras bu sor chud nasaḥ mi phyugs dal yams zhi ba dang ཿ (718)mu ge 'khrugs rtsed med pa dang ཿ sad ser btsa' than las rgyal teḥ 'jig rten bde ba'i phrin las mjodaḥ rjes la mchod gtor gtsang par gshegasaḥ phan pa'i yon tan brjod mi langasaḥ lag tu blangs pas yid ches 'gyuraḥ sa ma yāḥ dha thimaḥ 'di 'bebs ran pa'i rtags su rmi lam na dkar thab shor ba mthong ba la 'khrugs skong ni gtor dpe bstan pa sogs byung bas brda rang grol du gyur toḥ ཿ
